login.title: Company cards
login.lead: HQ, BL, ML, and SL operators and cardholders sign in on the same screen.

stats.feeHint: Organization fees come out of the limit. User fees appear on the transaction.

org.name: Organization name
org.reassignHint: Change cards and limit within what the parent still has.
org.renameHint: The level code stays HQ, BL, ML, or SL. Only the name changes, the same way a merchant name is set at registration.

account.title: Add account
account.hint: Users can be added on BL, ML, or SL. An account cannot move to another organization.
account.name: Name

spend.title: Record payment
spend.hint: A usage fee applies, and an extra fee applies when the amount is at or below the threshold. Only the organization share comes out of this limit.

charge.title: Run a fee
charge.hint: Apply a newly added fee event to this card. Issue, use, block, unblock, reissue, ATM, and monthly already charge from their own buttons.

fee.title: Fee channel
fee.lead: Each fee adds a percent and a fixed crypto amount. Markup order is W, HQ, BL, ML, SL. HQ edits every cell. Each organization edits only its own level.
fee.scope: The table shows the levels above the organization selected on the left. Organization fees come out of that limit. User fees appear on the user statement.
fee.empty: No fees yet. HQ adds a fee, then the markup cells appear.

user.lead: Fees you pay appear here. Fees the organization pays come out of that organization's limit.

event.under: Extra fee at or below an amount

api.hq_only: Only an HQ operator can change this.
api.fee_rate: The fee percent must be from 0 to 100.
api.cards_int: Card count must be a whole number of 0 or more.
api.limit_min: The limit must be 0 or more.
api.cards_floor: Card count cannot go below what is already assigned.
api.limit_floor: The limit cannot go below what is already assigned.
api.operator_org: Only operators can create an organization.
api.parent_forbidden: That parent organization cannot be selected.
api.no_child: An organization cannot be created under SL.
api.cards_over: That is more cards than the parent has left.
api.limit_over: That is more limit than the parent has left.
api.parent_missing: The parent organization was not found.
api.cards_range: Card count cannot be set to that range.
api.limit_range: The limit cannot be set to that range.
api.operator_account: Only operators can create an account.
api.password_short: Password must be at least 4 characters.
api.account_forbidden: An account cannot be created in this organization.
api.user_level: Users belong on BL, ML, or SL. An account cannot move later.
api.limit_short: The organization limit is too low, including fees the organization pays.
api.hq_event: Only HQ can add a fee event.
api.event_code: The event code must use letters and numbers.
api.hq_event_delete: Only HQ can delete a fee event.
api.event_in_use: A fee still uses this event, so it cannot be deleted.
api.hq_fee: Only HQ can add a fee.
api.threshold_min: The threshold must be 0 or more.
api.under_threshold: An at-or-below fee needs a threshold amount.
api.w_rate: W cost must be 0 or more, and the percent must be 100 or less.
api.hq_rate: HQ margin must be 0 or more, and the percent must be 100 or less.
api.markup_level: Markup applies only on BL, ML, and SL.
api.markup_self: You can change only your own organization's markup.
api.markup_forbidden: This organization's markup cannot be changed.
api.markup_rate: Markup must be 0 or more, and the percent must be 100 or less.
api.hq_fee_delete: Only HQ can delete a fee.
api.operator_card: Only operators can issue a card.
api.cards_empty: This organization has no cards left.
api.operator_spend: Only operators can record a payment.
api.amount_min: The payment amount must be greater than 0.
api.operator_card_edit: Only operators can change a card.
api.block_active: Only an active card can be blocked.
api.unblock_blocked: Only a blocked card can be unblocked.
api.reissue_cards: There is no card left to reissue.
api.monthly_active: Monthly fees apply only to an active card.
api.monthly_done: This month has already been charged.
api.charge_closed: A closed card cannot be charged.
api.atm_active: Only an active card can withdraw.
api.atm_amount: The withdrawal amount must be greater than 0.
api.hq_quota: Change the HQ card count and limit in the HQ pool.
